subject: ci: add Codecov workflow for unit and integration test coverage (#1319)
reason: The change is purely CI/test infrastructure: it adds a Codecov GitHub Actions workflow and codecov.yml, installs lcov in the devcontainer image, hardens ci/build_ubuntu.sh (array-based argument forwarding, safer artifact copying, propagating cleanup errors into the exit code, a --debug flag), and fixes a Python integration test to measure net memory usage instead of absolute used_memory.
